title: Will of Stone
description: Millelith soldier Jiayi wants to send a gift to his daughter, Little Liu, but he has no time to return to Qingce Village, and as such is looking for someone to help him out...

mainQuestExcel.title: Will of Stone
mainQuestExcel.description: Millelith soldier Jiayi wants to send a gift to his daughter, Little Liu, but he has no time to return to Qingce Village, and as such is looking for someone to help him out...

dialogs.text: *sigh* I was counting down the days before I'd be able to go back. Just two or three days more...
With all the leave I've saved up until this point, I could have spent over a week together with Little Liu.
But with but one order, all our leaves were canceled. Even the people on leave were recalled.
In my experience, this means at least another month without any hope of returning to Qingce Village. What terrible luck...
Oh, where has that child run off to...
Can I ask about Little Liu?
Are you looking for her? *sigh* What perfectly terrible timing. I don't know where's she's gone.
She received a letter that her father asked someone to send over from Liyue Harbor that stated that he'd be back soon.
Little Liu was so happy. She said she wanted to prepare a gift for her father, and roped some other children into picking fruits and flowers...
But a few days afterward, he sent word, saying that he had a last-minute assignment and wouldn't be able to return.
She threw a tantrum, and nothing we said could dissuade her from insisting that she would go to Liyue Harbor herself, since her father wasn't coming.
We thought it a joke for a while. But this morning, she was gone.
*sigh* We've already sent people out to look for her, but if you're willing, you can join in as well.
I'll give it a go.
I apologize for the trouble. *sigh* This child...
Where do you think she's headed?
I doubt she could go far. She's probably still close by, but the wilds are a dangerous place... Please, find her quickly.
That Jiayi, too. How could he just cancel on his daughter like that...
She doesn't see him any more than a few times a year. Is this how a father should behave?
He's doing this for Liyue Harbor...
That's what he says every year. I've lost count of the number of times he's said that...
He's just doing his job...
Well, it's also his job to take care of his daughter. Little Liu is growing up day by day.
If he's not careful, she'll be the one going out to work by the time he returns.
This father and his daughter just can't get together, can they?
Are you here to catch me and take me back to Qingce Village?
Granny Ruoxin is worried sick about you.
Hmph. So you are here to catch me. Well, I'm not going back.
Go back and tell the villagers that I'm going to Liyue Harbor to look for Daddy.
They don't have to worry. Once I find him, I'll just talk to him for a while, then I'll come back.
I have something for you...
I don't need anything from you. You're just trying to bribe me.

flow.stepDescription: Catch up to Little Liu (if she gets more than 30m away, the quest will be failed)

dialogs.text: What are you following me for, anyway? I said, I'm going to Liyue Harbor!
I'll get around these monsters myself. They won't find me.
Don't treat me like a kid! I'm a grown-up now!
This is from your father...
From Daddy? Did he ask you to send it over...
I'm sure it's more things for children to play with... if it's not kites, it's dolls.
You don't like them?
...I do. It's something Daddy gave me. How could I not like it?
But if I always like these things, doesn't that mean that I'll always be a kid?
If I keep playing with them, when will I become an adventurer, or get my own Vision?
What did you want a Vision for, again?
If I had a Vision, I'd be able to do so many things, whether it be making money or something else...
Then, Daddy wouldn't have to work in Liyue Harbor all the time. He could come back and spend time with me.
Right now, I can't even go to Liyue Harbor myself without a Vision...
But since Daddy has already sent you here with his presents, I might just be giving him more trouble by going to look for him.
<color=#00E1FFFF>I had presents ready for him too</color>. I wanted to give him a surprise... But I can't take them to him now.
<color=#00E1FFFF>If only someone could help me do that</color>... It's alright. I'm going back. There's no need to follow me, I know the way home.
You've returned. Thank you for your help. Little Liu has already returned, and with quite the bag of things, too.
Jiayi sent them to her.
Did he, now... But still, what Little Liu really wants is for him to come back in person.
That child really has grown up like the bamboo around the village. Blink, and you'll miss just how much she's grown.
The days when your child is young will never return again once you miss them...
Dolls... kites... pinwheels. Daddy sent these again, just like I thought.
*sigh* It's just a shame that I wasn't able to send him my gifts too.
I'll take them to your father.
You'll help me? Well... Even though you don't have a Vision either, it looked like those monsters didn't give you a hard time at all.
I guess we'll have to do it this way, then. Thank you.
*sigh* If only I could be as strong as you...

Have you handed the presents to Little Liu yet?
I have.
That's good. Those toys are her favorite. Thank you — please take these as a token of my thanks.
She'd prefer it if you were home.
I want to go back too. But with Liyue Harbor in this state, I don't think that's possible for the time being.
Still, thank you so much. I hope those presents will improve her mood a bit — they are her favorites, after all.
Please, take this as thanks.

Have you handed the presents to Little Liu yet?
Well, this is from Little Liu.
This... is from Little Liu, for me? So many... How much work did she have to put in...
I want nothing more than to drop everything and run back to Qingce Village right now. But the Ministry of Civil Affairs would...
Thank you once again. Take these as thanks, please.
*sigh* I have no idea when this whole affair will be over, or when the Ministry will approve my leave, either...
If only I had a Vision! With it, I could do so many things, whether it's making money or whatever...
At least, I would have no trouble making it to Liyue on my own.
But, how do I get my hands on one...
